# txfinality.com

> How long for a stablecoin transfer to finalize on blockchains? Measured, not claimed: the slowest of 20 real transfers of 0.04–0.1 USDC, USDT or USDG on each chain, sent one at a time, timed from sending to each finality level the chain itself defines, with every transaction hash published. Method v0, built 2026-10-23.

Two figures per chain: done is the earliest level at which the chain says the transfer will not be dropped; final is the chain's own last level. Figures are rounded up (≤). Chains are the top 15 by USD stablecoin supply (DefiLlama, 2026-10-18) plus a few by decision; a chain whose final takes minutes by design is listed with its documented figure and not measured.

chain | done | final | status
Solana | 0.9 s | 0.9 s | measured, run 2026-10-23T0634Z
Arc | 1.4 s | 1.4 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1048Z
TON | 2.4 s | 2.4 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1658Z
BNB Chain | 2.0 s | 2.8 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1055Z
Hyperliquid | 2.8 s | 2.8 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1048Z
Plasma | 1.1 s | 3.0 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1456Z
Polygon PoS | 2.3 s | 7.0 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1434Z
Avalanche | 4.9 s | 11.0 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1151Z
XRP Ledger | 13.3 s | 13.3 s | measured, run 2026-10-19T1701Z
X Layer | 1.6 s | 17 min | measured, run 2026-10-19T1755Z
Arbitrum One | 0.8 s | 19 min | measured, run 2026-10-19T1519Z
Robinhood Chain | 0.9 s | 19 min | measured, run 2026-10-19T1538Z
Base | 1.3 s | 22 min | measured, run 2026-10-19T1559Z
Tron | 60.0 s | 60.0 s | by design, from the docs, not measured
Ethereum | 7 min | 13 min | by design, from the docs, not measured
Bitcoin | 10 min | 60 min | by design, from the docs, not measured

## Results

- [data.json](https://txfinality.com/data.json): every row as data — figures, every level, the run's stamp, RPC host and hashes
- [runs/](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/tree/main/runs): one JSON per run per chain, each transfer with its hash and the seconds to each level
- [landscape/](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/tree/main/landscape): the ranking by stablecoin supply on the day, and who is listed

## Method and code

- [METHOD.md](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/blob/main/docs/METHOD.md): the rules, versioned (v0)
- [measure/](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/tree/main/measure): the runner (TypeScript, Node 22+) — run.ts is the clock, chains/*.ts the drivers (evm, solana, ton, xrpl, aptos)
- [chains/](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/tree/main/chains): one YAML per chain — asset, levels in the chain's own words, the claim quoted from its docs
- [docs/research/](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/tree/main/docs/research): what each chain's docs say, quoted, with dates
- [README](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com#readme): how to run it yourself for any chain with one wallet and an RPC URL
- [news.md](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/blob/main/news.md): what changed, run by run

## Optional

- [Report a correction](https://github.com/burmisov/txfinality.com/issues)
